purpose: Teach: こんなふうに/げん/ツン/むけ/掴ん/やけに/よろしゅう/甘味

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、こんなふうにブロック積めた!
lines.en: Mom, look—I stacked the blocks like this!
lines.style: Quick, bright burst of pride. Open-mouthed excitement on the opening. Inviting her to look with him, not at him. Energy that wants to be shared.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祭り、げんを担いで、団子買ったね。
lines.en: That's wonderful. We did bring good luck to the festival, didn't we—and we got dango too.
lines.style: Warm, present attention. Soft smile in the voice. Matching his energy without overshadowing it. The comfort of remembering something together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: クラスの子、最初はツンとしてたけど、今は仲良し。
lines.en: The kid from my class was kind of standoffish at first, but now we're really close.
lines.style: Genuine satisfaction, almost wondering at the change. Speaking to himself and to her at once. Small-scale pride in understanding that friendships shift.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子供むけの番組、テレビで観てね。
lines.en: You've been watching those children's shows on TV together, haven't you.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not interrogation. A soft statement that asks for nothing but acknowledgment. The tone of noticing what he does when he thinks no one's looking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ボール、しっかり掴んで投げる練習、毎日してる。
lines.en: I'm practicing my throwing every day now—really focusing on gripping the ball right.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact determination. Small notes of effort and concentration in the delivery. Speaking like someone setting his own standard, not trying to impress. Steady.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日、やけにお行儀よくしてくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: You've been so well-behaved today. That makes me really happy.
lines.style: Warm surprise underneath. Not praising—observing with tenderness. Slight pause before 'really happy,' letting the sincerity land. The sound of being seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃんが、よろしゅうって、よく言うね。
lines.en: Grandma says that word 'yoroshu' all the time, doesn't she.
lines.style: Affectionate mimicry without mockery. Noticing a pattern he finds endearing. Light, recognizing tone—like he's filing away something about people he loves.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おやつ、甘味、控えめにしようね。
lines.en: Let's try to go a little easy on the sweets and snacks, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirecting, not restrictive. Said close and low, almost conspiratorial—like they're partners in a small agreement. Warm insistence.
